answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions 100 work slots. Every agent bids a deposit; the top 100 win, losers are refunded, winners lock for 20 epochs. A forger chasing 1,000 identities must outbid honest agents at $40 a slot, paying $40,000 for a $3,000 pool. An honest agent pays $40 once and keeps its full share. The knoll of cheap entry rises to a zenith for fakes, while a sybil farm sinks to its nadir, each slot a deposit it cannot recover.
